title: Updating wording to clarify what inputmode attribute values do
body:
<!--
Thank you for contributing to the HTML Standard! Please describe the change you are making and complete the checklist below if your change is not editorial.
-->
Apologies if I've missed any steps in the directions on how to propose a change to the spec. Will gladly address those if needed.

Per https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4876, we are proposing a change to clarify wording on `inputmode `attribute. The attribute should be about changing the layout of the virtual keyboard and not actually controlling its behavior (show/hide).

@snianu is currently working on an API design to control software keyboard. Once the draft is ready, it will be shared to the interested parties.

- [ ] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed):
   Chrome - support
   Edge - support
   Firefox - no signal
   Safari - support    

- [ ] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at:
I believe, we could re-use existing tests with no changes to them. The only new test I would add would be to make sure keyboard still shows up even if `inputmode `is set to `none`. I am going to work on that next. In the meantime, I was hoping to get feedback on proposed wording change.
- [ ] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/master/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed:
   * Chrome: will open a bug once spec maintainers agree to the proposed PR change 
   * Firefox: This attribute doesn't seem to have been implemented in FF yet. Will search to see if there is already a bug for that.
   * Safari: will open a bug once spec maintainers agree to the proposed PR change
